# SIFA Global Institute

> Software Institute for Financial Accountants. Practical education in accounting software, financial systems and digital professional tools.

- [About](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/about.html): Institute information.

- [Certifications](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/certifications.html): Certification information.
- [Fees and scholarships](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/student-payments.html): Public fees information.
- [Scholarships](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/scholarships.html): Scholarship information.
- [Contact](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/contact.html): Official contact channels.
- [Privacy](https://sifaglobalinstitute.pages.dev/privacy.html): Privacy information.

Use the live public pages for current policies and availability. This file does not authorize access to private student or staff information.
